title: A Multi-Agent Conversational Bandit Approach to Online Evaluation and Selection of User-Aligned LLM Responses
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development of a multi-agent conversational bandit algorithm (MACO) for online evaluation of LLM response quality. While it includes a brief 'Ethics Statement' indicating no ethical concerns were raised by the research, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
